dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about ores in Natlan?

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Sorry, I haven't heard of any good mining outcrops lately. Perhaps they've all been mined already.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Tell you what, come find me another time. If I hear of anything, I'll be sure to share it with you.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Two, four, five... Oh, looks like I missed the beat again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Please, go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: What do you need? Let me see if I can make a sturdier one for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'd like something made.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Your previous order is complete. Do you have any other requests?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What beat?

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just playing some intense music in my head — the kind that's perfect for forging.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: I'm guessing you can't hear it? It's a pity that I'm tone-deaf as well, or I'd try singing it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: But feel free to stand by and listen to the rhythm of my ironworking. Just think of it as a form of street music.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'd like to buy some weapons.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Sure thing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's quite the rhythm.

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: I'm not sure why, but this kind of rhythm helps relieve my fatigue from all the repetitive toil. Really keeps my energy levels up, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Alom
dialogues.text: Yeah, stone can sometimes serve as a musical instrument.
